verdict.rationale: BigCommerce has a dedicated first-party Webhooks section in its developer docs, including an overview page and a Google Cloud Platform Pub/Sub webhook delivery option. That indicates a supported event-subscription mechanism. However, the evidence consists mostly of page titles with little substantive detail. Missing for 10: documented event/topic catalog, details of the subscription API (create/list/delete hooks), delivery guarantees, retries and payload signing, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
